title: Constrained optimal impulse control and inventory model
summary: In this article, we consider the deterministic impulsively controlled system with infinite horizon and several discounted objective functionals. The constructed optimal control problem with functional constraints is reformulated as a Markov decision process, leading to (primal) convex and linear programs in the space of so-called occupation measures. We construct the dual programs and investigate the solvability of all the programs. Example of an inventory model illustrates the developed theory.
